template_data.headline_html: Four myths killing real GSA candidates.

items.title: You need federal past performance
items.desc: GSA evaluates commercial work. What you've done for private clients counts toward approval.

items.title: It costs too much
items.desc: The barrier is 100+ hours of paperwork, not cash. That's the investment — and it's transferable.

items.title: Only big companies win
items.desc: $23.1B went to small businesses in Q3 2026. The market is there. The positioning isn't.

items.title: The Schedule sells itself
items.desc: Access without a sales strategy is an expensive shelf decoration. The Schedule is a door, not a deal.
